meta.name: add-whatsapp-cloud
meta.description: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK. Official Meta API.

copy.tagline: 集成 WhatsApp 云 API 到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 WhatsApp 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WhatsApp Cloud API into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add WhatsApp messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 就能通过 WhatsApp 官方接口收发一对一消息。你要先在 Meta 后台建好应用并填好四个密钥,之后消息才能通。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp、配置官方 API,或运行渠道管理命令(如 /manage-channels)时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp。
say.note: 会拷贝适配器并注册渠道。

say.text: 给我配置 WhatsApp Cloud 渠道。
say.note: 会引导你粘贴四个密钥到 .env。

say.text: 验证 WhatsApp 渠道是否正常工作。
say.note: 会运行构建和测试确认无误。

howto.what_en: Lets NanoClaw send and receive one-on-one WhatsApp messages via the official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API. You must set up a Meta app first and provide four credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect WhatsApp, configure the official API, or run a channel-management command like /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Help me connect NanoClaw to WhatsApp.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and registers the channel.

say_en.text: Set up WhatsApp Cloud API for my account.
say_en.note: Prompts you to paste four credentials into .env.

say_en.text: Check whether the WhatsApp channel works.
say_en.note: Runs the build and the registration test.
